item.description:
Thimble 0.4.0 syncs through a storage bucket of your own, with no folder app on each device.
- Settings > Sync > Use a Bucket… syncs through any S3-compatible bucket, such as Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, or MinIO. Paste a Sync Key, or fill in the bucket's address, name, and access key to make one. - Show Sync Key… gives the key as a QR code and as text, to set up your other devices. - Everything is still encrypted with your passphrase before it leaves the Mac. The bucket sees how many files there are and when they change, never what's in them. - Only sync goes online, and only to the bucket you give it. With a folder, or with sync off, Thimble stays offline as before.
